steps.title: Install VRChat on the headset
steps.explanation: Open Meta Horizon Store inside the headset and install VRChat. No PC streaming software is needed.
steps.expectedResult: VRChat appears in the headset's installed library.
steps.verification: Check the headset library in Meta Horizon Store to confirm VRChat finished downloading.
steps.onFailure: Check headset Wi-Fi connectivity and available storage in Meta Horizon Store, then retry the download.

steps.title: Open VRChat in the headset
steps.explanation: Launch VRChat directly on the headset and sign in through the official in-headset flow.
steps.expectedResult: VRChat opens in standalone mode and enters the home world.
steps.verification: Confirm audio, controller tracking and sign-in inside the headset.
steps.onFailure: Restart the application on the headset and review official account linking guidance if sign-in fails.

lastVerification.environment: Official upstream documentation catalog review (no unverified hardware session claim)
